    colDate: 'Data',
    colProject: 'Projeto',
    colHours: 'Horas',
    to: 'a',
  },
} satisfies Record<Lang, Record<string, string>>

export const filters: Record<Lang, Record<Filter, string>> = {
  en: { today: 'Today', week: 'Week', month: 'Month', all: 'All' },
  pt: { today: 'Hoje', week: 'Semana', month: 'Mês', all: 'Tudo' },
}

const weekdays = { en: ['Sun', 'Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat'], pt: ['dom', 'seg', 'ter', 'qua', 'qui', 'sex', 'sáb'] }
const months = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec']

/** A day key as a row reads it: `seg 12/10` or `Mon Oct 12`; with the year, `seg 12/10/2026` or `Mon Oct 12, 2026`. */
export function dayLabel(day: string, lang: Lang, withYear = false): string {
  const d = new Date(`${day}T00:00`) // no offset: local time
  const wd = weekdays[lang][d.getDay()]
  const year = day.slice(0, 4)
  if (lang === 'pt') return `${wd} ${day.slice(8)}/${day.slice(5, 7)}${withYear ? `/${year}` : ''}`
  return `${wd} ${months[d.getMonth()]} ${d.getDate()}${withYear ? `, ${year}` : ''}`
}

// Copy as Markdown: the selected folder's days in the period as a table for the hours report. Pure.
import type { Filter } from '../types'
import { dayLabel, filters, strings, type Lang } from './i18n'
import { formatDuration, formatTotal } from './time'
import { folderName, relativeName, type FolderDay } from './tree'

/** A day key as the title writes it: `12/10/2026` or `2026-10-12`. */
const date = (day: string, lang: Lang) => (lang === 'pt' ? `${day.slice(8)}/${day.slice(5, 7)}/${day.slice(0, 4)}` : day)

/**
 * Title with the folder and the period, one row per day (with its year) and project (the path
 * relative to the folder), a Total row, `*` on corrected rows and a footnote. Hours as `Xh MMmin`,
 * never rounded. `range` is the filter's period; for every day, the first and last day with time.
 */
export function markdownTable(folder: string, days: readonly FolderDay[], filter: Filter, range: readonly [string, string], lang: Lang): string {
  const s = strings[lang]
  const [from, to] = filter === 'all' ? [days[0]?.day ?? '', days.at(-1)?.day ?? ''] : range
  const when = from === to ? date(from, lang) : `${date(from, lang)} ${s.to} ${date(to, lang)}`
  const rows = days.flatMap(d =>
    d.entries.map(e => `| ${dayLabel(d.day, lang, true)} | ${relativeName(e.project, folder)} | ${formatDuration(e.ms)}${e.corrected ? ' *' : ''} |`),
  )
  return [
    `## ${folderName(folder)} · ${filters[lang][filter]}, ${when}`,
    '',
    `| ${s.colDate} | ${s.colProject} | ${s.colHours} |`,
    '| --- | --- | ---: |',
    ...rows,
    `| **${s.total}** | | **${formatTotal(days)}** |`,
    '',
    ...(days.some(d => d.corrected) ? [`\\${s.corrected}`, ''] : []),
  ].join('\n')
}

// The status line text: `⏱ <time today> today · <project folder>`, `⏸` while paused. Pure.
import { strings, type Lang } from './i18n'
import { formatDuration } from './time'
import { folderName } from './tree'

/** `today` is the project's time shown for today: every session's, corrections applied, as the panel shows it. */
export const statusText = (today: number, project: string, lang: Lang, paused: boolean) =>
  `${paused ? '⏸' : '⏱'} ${formatDuration(today)} ${strings[lang].today} · ${folderName(project)}`
